text:
Sarah P: @here Orbit Cloud procurement ping — customer Frostbyte Inc submitted PO #56789 but it routed to Orbit's vendor record in the marketplace portal. Their procurement portal shows status 'awaiting vendor approval'. Our marketplace listing shows 'vendor: OrbitCloud' somehow. Can someone confirm mapping?

Mike D: FYI this is blocking the customer's invoice timeline. They need Redwood as payee for our revenue recognition. I escalated to Orbit partnerships but they say it's on their side.

Anya L: Share the PO PDF and the marketplace order id. If Orbit is the payee we need a corrected PO or a signed addendum.

Sarah P: Attached — PO56789.pdf (link) — marketplace order ID: MKT-89412. Procurement says their system auto-sent to vendor in their marketplace flow.

Leo S: Pinged the buyer contact; they said "we selected Redwood" but portal defaulted to Orbit. Could be listing metadata. Jordan can you check our vendor mapping in the marketplace portal?

Jordan O: Looking. On the vendor portal our partner integration shows `reseller: OrbitCloud` flag enabled. I can flip routing but need partner approval. If we change without Orbit, we might break invoicing. What's the customer's timeline?

Mike D: Customer requests invoice by EOW (Fri). If we can't get corrected PO, we might accept route via Orbit and do revenue share, but legal needs to sign an SOW amendment.

Anya L: We can do a short addendum that we will be provider-of-record even if invoice flows to Orbit; need Orbit to countersign. Drafting now.

Sarah P: Also, Orbit returned a redline on our marketplace MSA clause 7 (IP indemnity) and marked 'we must be reseller only'. They want us to remove provider-of-record language.

Anya L: Share partner redlines. We should not concede provider-of-record removal. Send redlines and I'll push back.

Jordan O: Quick fix possibility: marketplace admin API has a `purchase_order_routing` field. Current value: `vendor`. Could switch to `seller` which sets Redwood. Sample call: ```PATCH /api/v1/listings/MKT-89412 { "purchase_order_routing": "seller" }``` I can run this but need Orbit partnership ops to accept change.

Sarah P: If Orbit won't approve, we need Deal Desk to authorize manual override. @Mike D can you open a Deal Desk ticket with priority high? Include PO, order id, customer timeline.

Mike D: On it. Created ticket #DD-4921 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-4921. Noted 'customer invoice required by 2026-03-27'. Also cc'ing @Anya L.

orchid-bot: ticket DD-4921 updated: status=escalated to deal-desk; owner=Mike D; due=2026-03-27

Anya L: I'll draft the addendum now and share in 30m. If Orbit doesn't sign, we escalate to Partnerships leadership for negotiation.

Sarah P: Thanks. Action items: Jordan attempt API toggle with Orbit approval; Mike escalate Deal Desk; Anya draft addendum. I'll coordinate with buyer. :thumbsup:
